question: Which status has been conferred to Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) by the Government of India in October 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mini Ratna.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), one of India’s oldest shipbuilding entities, has been conferred **Mini Ratna status** by the Government of India on October 14, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Mini Ratna status grants greater financial and operational autonomy to public sector enterprises like HSL, including the ability to form joint ventures and approve investments without prior government approval.
 
• The recognition marks a significant turnaround for HSL, which has consistently posted profits in nine of the last ten years, except during the COVID-19 disruption in 2020–21.
 
• HSL’s revival is attributed to a series of reforms, including financial restructuring, technology upgrades, and workforce reskilling.
 
• This designation will enhance HSL’s ability to take on advanced naval projects, strengthening its role in India’s maritime defence ecosystem.
 
• Founded in 1941; Despite being transferred to the Ministry of Defence in 2010, its revival took shape only after 2015, when a series of strategic reforms were implemented.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mini Ratna Status**__: Provides increased autonomy to public sector enterprises, enabling them to make decisions more independently.
 
• __**Strategic Importance**__: Supports India’s Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative and boosts its maritime defence capabilities.
 
• __**Revival Efforts**__: HSL’s recovery after 2015 is a result of focused reforms, including improved project management and technological advancements.
 
• __**Global Competitiveness**__: Mini Ratna status allows HSL to collaborate with both public and private players in cutting-edge technologies.
